title: Administration signed out
purpose: Confirm that the administration session has ended.
summary: You have signed out of administration.

tasks.title: Sign in again
steps: Select [[Log in again]]. You go to the application sign-in page.

tasks.title: Go to administration home
steps: Select [[Home]] in the breadcrumbs. Signed out, it leads to the sign-in page.

good_to_know: Log out signs out at once; there is no confirmation step.
The sign-out is the same as signing out from the application's account menu.
The sign-out is recorded in the application logs.

sections.title: State
paragraphs: This is the result of submitting Log out in the administration header. The action signs out immediately; there is no pre-sign-out confirmation. With no Django logout redirect configured, the response displays the stock signed-out page. Direct GET requests to this endpoint are not accepted.

items.label: Log in again
items.description: Opens administration home, which sends signed-out visitors to the application sign-in page.

items.label: Home
items.description: The breadcrumb also returns to administration home/login. No credentials or other editable fields are shown here.

sections.title: Sign-out activity
paragraphs: Ending an authenticated administration session records the same sign-out event as the account menu, with the stored username in the deployment’s application logs. These logs follow the deployment’s retention and survive database resets; they are separate from laboratory record audit history.
